status: planning proposals; not a runtime registry
contractQualification: Family assignment is triage, not scene-level UI completion. Exact subject/actor/method, producer and response need situation qualification.

contracts.title: Local movement
contracts.operation: Choose a supported destination and route; commit movement.
contracts.result_consumer: New actual location and its admitted nearby actions.
contracts.missing: Resolve source origin/destination, actual actor, route and scene timing; a changed scene place is not a walk command.
contracts.failure_check: Change an entrance permission between quote and departure; no free relocation or stale route acceptance.
contracts.later_pressure: Remote movement, regional permissions and operation-specific reach cannot use one global range flag.
contracts.future_freedom: Alternate supported route or transport can reach the same destination; canon-mode restrictions have their own reason.

contracts.title: Paid and regional transport
contracts.operation: Reserve the selected actual service, attend it and arrive.
contracts.result_consumer: Fare settlement and actual new location; commitments affected by arrival time.
contracts.missing: Qualify timetable, provider means, origin and fare; inherited guessed origins remain gaps.
contracts.failure_check: Miss departure after reservation; apply the declared refund/loss once and return to the originating route.
contracts.later_pressure: Different body/cargo and remote arrival methods may need different carrier admission.
contracts.future_freedom: Walk, negotiate another supplier or use an acquired travel method when its mechanism supports it.

contracts.title: Waiting and appointments
families: wait for a time or event
contracts.operation: Select a named local deadline or interval supported by its clock.
contracts.result_consumer: Due event/attendance and the next real task.
contracts.missing: Source time bands do not supply exact minutes; bind actual scene/day/window.
contracts.failure_check: Wait across an appointment boundary with another job active; preserve declared occupied time and distinguish missed attendance.
contracts.later_pressure: Multiple bodies, institutions and maintained effects can consume different clocks.
contracts.future_freedom: Choose another supported use of the interval without silently fast-forwarding harmful or unresolved decisions.

contracts.title: Conversation and social approach
contracts.operation: Choose an admitted topic and actual response to a present or reachable person.
contracts.result_consumer: Attributed response and any actual consent, service or relationship effect.
contracts.missing: Greeting is not a topic-specific answer; qualify speakers, consent and result.
contracts.failure_check: Person departs or refuses; topic history remains without inventing consent or another speaker.
contracts.later_pressure: Aliases, remote bodies and public standing do not establish source/control identity.
contracts.future_freedom: Different honest or deceptive approaches need actual NPC motives and means, not a lead-only success grant.

contracts.title: Messages and received reports
contracts.operation: Compose/send through an actual channel; separately receive and acknowledge.
contracts.result_consumer: Recipient-specific admitted knowledge and next inquiry/task.
contracts.missing: A report renderer is not a delivery mechanism; qualify address, reach, sender, receiver and carrier.
contracts.failure_check: Lose the channel after send; no delivery/knowledge merely because the original scene says the message was sent.
contracts.later_pressure: LOTM addressed responder and delegated body remain distinct from HP disclosure authority and MoL channel technology.
contracts.future_freedom: A physical courier, direct contact or acquired communication method can differ in cost, time and exposure.

contracts.title: Inspection, investigation and appraisal
contracts.operation: Select a subject, investigation method and evidence-producing operation.
contracts.result_consumer: A sourced observation or inference used by another decision.
contracts.missing: Resolve physical subject, evidence kind and downstream consumer; a description is not an assay or proof.
contracts.failure_check: Compare remembered appraisal to a changed object; do not display stale inference as current physical truth.
contracts.later_pressure: Historical traces, hazardous information and proxy appearance require separate evidence admission.
contracts.future_freedom: Other reasonable methods may establish different aspects with different uncertainty; no universal inspect button.

contracts.title: Perception and observation
contracts.operation: Admit an event through actual senses, channel or deliberate observation.
contracts.result_consumer: Witnessed or reported knowledge, with physical control still evaluated separately.
contracts.missing: Classify passive occurrence versus paid/deliberate observation; a verb tag alone cannot choose a button.
contracts.failure_check: Keep perception valid while control/acquisition fails; badge/search counts must reveal no hidden event.
contracts.later_pressure: Operation-specific reach and observer tolerance; observing a result does not identify its hidden controller.
contracts.future_freedom: Change vantage, use an actual instrument or seek an account through a supported channel.

contracts.title: Documents, memory and writing references
contracts.operation: Access the actual carrier, use a reading method and retain an attributed account.
contracts.result_consumer: Retained account and physical carrier state consumed independently.
contracts.missing: JR1 selected source scene/carrier still needs qualification; destruction/copying need actual effects.
contracts.failure_check: Destroy one carrier then reread remembered account; no global erasure or duplicated original after import.
contracts.later_pressure: LR3-L2 exposure and KP proposal: ordinary reference redraw does not create a new acquisition or immunity.
contracts.future_freedom: Copy, summarize, ask a reader or use acquired protection through real means; source access and safe comprehension remain distinct.

contracts.title: Reasoning and planning
contracts.operation: Select available evidence and record an inference or plan, distinct from execution.
contracts.result_consumer: An attributed inference or draft consumed by the next real command.
contracts.missing: A thought may be narration, not a command; source result and missing evidence must be retained.
contracts.failure_check: A contradictory report revises the inference while preserving earlier provenance; no changed world fact from drafting.
contracts.later_pressure: Historical evidence, concealed identities and later hindsight cannot auto-complete an early deduction.
contracts.future_freedom: Permit alternative plans whose steps have supported mechanisms; user notes are not authoritative character knowledge.

contracts.title: Study and experimental research
contracts.operation: Learn from an actual source or conduct a method-bound experiment.
contracts.result_consumer: Learned method or evidence with a usable next experiment/application.
contracts.missing: Separate observation, interpretation, learned execution and faculty; classify each reader row before assigning an operation.
contracts.failure_check: A failed experiment consumes its declared inputs without granting the hoped-for method or erasing a valid negative result.
contracts.later_pressure: Later knowledge hazards and source substitution require method/protection/provenance, not a global researched flag.
contracts.future_freedom: Invent or combine techniques where mechanisms support them; unsupported simulation remains an explicit gap.

contracts.title: Practice and ability use
contracts.operation: Select a learned supported operation, actual source/tool, target and current quote.
contracts.result_consumer: Actual effect and qualified practice evidence, independently.
contracts.missing: Source faculty, technique, target and lasting progress must have actual producers; no gain from reading a label.
contracts.failure_check: Perception succeeds but reach fails; a stale target/source quote cannot spend or hit a replacement target.
contracts.later_pressure: LR2-L1/L2 operation stages and borrowed support; old command definitions retain revision policy.
contracts.future_freedom: An acquired equivalent means can work for a non-lead actor without hidden protagonist permission.

contracts.title: Divination and rituals
contracts.operation: Ask a specific question or prepare and execute a qualified ritual method.
contracts.result_consumer: Method-specific response/effect with evidence and an actual downstream decision.
contracts.missing: Separate divination, invocation, advancement and other rituals; authored fit/odds are not canon probabilities.
contracts.failure_check: Condition or responder support changes after preparation; settle according to that method, not a universal refund.
contracts.later_pressure: JR3–JR9: history, roles, substitutions and response support can change later; timer completion is not every ritual.
contracts.future_freedom: Alternative material or procedure works when its causal role is satisfied with actual means and costs.

contracts.title: Physical items and custody
contracts.operation: Take, give, store, equip or destroy the exact admitted physical carrier.
contracts.result_consumer: Actual custody and usability for work, trade or evidence.
contracts.missing: Resolve carrier/lot identity and current holder; an authored note does not transfer or consume stock.
contracts.failure_check: Lose/sell reserved support before another action; its old preparation flag cannot recreate the item.
contracts.later_pressure: Borrowed manifestations, characteristic provenance and delegated instruments need their own carrier laws.
contracts.future_freedom: Use available substitute tools/materials when mechanisms permit; possession alone does not grant skill or allegiance.

contracts.title: Trade, payment and household finance
contracts.operation: Choose actual counterpart, goods/claim, payer and terms; settle transfer.
contracts.result_consumer: Goods/funds/settled claim consumed by preparation or daily needs.
contracts.missing: Bind real purse/stock/currency and consequence; paying one local act is not every payment in a book.
contracts.failure_check: Quote exhausts stock or payer funds; no duplicate settlement on retry/import.
contracts.later_pressure: Public standing, source identity and actual benefit destination are independent of payment receipts.
contracts.future_freedom: Bargain, borrow, earn or find a different seller through real counterpart means; no forced price equalization.

contracts.title: Making, potions and written artifacts
contracts.operation: Choose a source-qualified process and actual input lots, tools, site and maker.
contracts.result_consumer: Actual product/record used, equipped, taught, sold or applied by an existing consumer.
contracts.missing: Distinguish handwriting, physical fabrication, potion preparation and sourced transformation; no shared recipe law by label.
contracts.failure_check: Support loss after consumption retains its exact phase settlement; output text alone does not establish a product.
contracts.later_pressure: Later projected inputs and lasting source carriers can require lifetime/provenance changes; HP and MoL making laws remain local.
contracts.future_freedom: Experiment with alternative processes that satisfy causal needs; do not restrict outcomes to an allowed-product list.

contracts.title: Daily life, rest and treatment
contracts.operation: Meet a current bodily need or treat a qualified condition with actual means.
contracts.result_consumer: Actual body/resource change and usable next activity.
contracts.missing: Routine, harmful condition and treatment are distinct; exact gains/durations need qualified source or labelled authored dials.
contracts.failure_check: Time passes without compatible care: do not clear injury or restore every source; expired help does not reverse completed treatment.
contracts.later_pressure: Changed bodies/forms, protective support and nonphysical harm need carrier-specific care.
contracts.future_freedom: Daily ordinary means remain useful where they causally work; alternate lives choose actual lodging/work/support.

contracts.title: Agreements, access and obligations
contracts.operation: Inspect terms, establish actual assent/authority and commit the particular agreement.
contracts.result_consumer: Actual obligation/access state consumed by a real service or action.
contracts.missing: Define authority, instrument, term revision and enforcement; a button or ledger projection is not supernatural binding.
contracts.failure_check: Read terms without accepting, then lose institutional access; no automatic breach of an unrelated agreement.
contracts.later_pressure: JR7/LR3-L1 delegation and support differ from public permission; HP binding law cannot be imported.
contracts.future_freedom: Negotiate a different supported deal or refuse; consequences follow actual agents/mechanisms rather than global reputation.

contracts.title: Work, institutions and service performance
contracts.operation: Accept and perform a concrete staffed task with attendance, materials and settlement.
contracts.result_consumer: Completed service, earned wage/credential or explicit failure and useful next access.
contracts.missing: Require actual staff, funds, knowledge and result consumer; institution template is not a source-complete employer.
contracts.failure_check: Supervisor leaves after work but before assessment; completed labor and permission/payment follow their distinct terms.
contracts.later_pressure: Changing city, identity and rank alter social access without defining a new magical faculty.
contracts.future_freedom: Earn, apprentice, offer a new service or use a different institution with real willingness and resources.

contracts.title: Combat, evasion and aftermath
contracts.operation: Respond to an actual opposed situation with the current actor, means and target.
contracts.result_consumer: Actual opponent/body/aftermath state, attributed report and recovery task.
contracts.missing: L2b below-floor publication/persistence and L2c witness/interrupt remain; seeded card proof is not source-scene combat coverage.
contracts.failure_check: Failed withdrawal applies its declared consequence and agrees with native health; no safe-exit promise or unwitnessed knowledge.
contracts.later_pressure: Remote actuators, hidden controllers, harm carriers and later body forms do not fit one generic damage bar.
contracts.future_freedom: Negotiation, preparation, escape and alternative supported methods use the same actual world means, not forced balance.

contracts.title: Change state or maintain support
contracts.operation: Perform the particular supported transition or maintenance operation.
contracts.result_consumer: The changed state actually used by an ability, body or service.
contracts.missing: Class label alone does not identify progression, identity, source activation or upkeep; qualify the operation.
contracts.failure_check: End one support source while another remains; no universal reset/refill or deletion of independent learning.
contracts.later_pressure: Later-source state/provenance and body transitions may need versioned refactor.
contracts.future_freedom: Other supported transition methods remain possible with their real in-world costs and aftermath.

contracts.title: Delegation and indirect actors
contracts.operation: Assign a task through an admitted order channel to an actual acting body/decision source.
contracts.result_consumer: Actual response and separately delivered task evidence.
contracts.missing: Missing source-qualified actuator/controller/link/handover model; actor appearance is insufficient.
contracts.failure_check: Change controller support while a command is pending; preserve observer ignorance and reject stale authority.
contracts.later_pressure: LR2-L3/LR3-L1 delegated benefit destination; MoL shared fuel/report law is not LOTM agency law.
contracts.future_freedom: Hire, request, delegate or directly act through supported means; do not require every worker to simulate a full protagonist life.

contracts.title: Unresolved mechanism residue
contracts.operation: Retain the source situation and explicitly identify the missing mechanism before assigning a control.
contracts.result_consumer: A resolved source/mechanism/UI contract later; no pretend player action.
contracts.missing: No safe semantic match from the current tags.
contracts.failure_check: Every residue row retains its source ID; no silent fallback to greeting, walk, wait or report.
contracts.later_pressure: An unclassified late mechanism may change an early seam; do not force it into one of the existing adapters.
contracts.future_freedom: A new causal mechanism can justify a new world-local owner or a shared seam with demonstrated consumers.

contracts.title: Progression and source transitions
contracts.operation: Qualify, prepare, attempt and settle a particular progression method.
contracts.result_consumer: Acquired source/control and independent usable technique.
contracts.missing: Probationer progression is not automatically the lead route; exact advanced methods and scarcity are not supplied by an inventory counter.
contracts.failure_check: Prepared conditions without the final operation grant no promotion; partial result follows the qualified method.
contracts.later_pressure: JR3–JR5 and lead plan trajectory: material provenance, accumulated support, identity and later exceptions.
contracts.future_freedom: Reasonable substitutions or alternate progression routes depend on causal roles, costs and actual support, not a rank-only permission list.

contracts.title: Operation-specific reach and remote links
contracts.operation: Distinguish observation, initial acquisition, maintained control and movement.
contracts.result_consumer: Actual control/movement effect rather than mere target discovery.
contracts.missing: Missing qualified per-stage link/range/position and interruption producers.
contracts.failure_check: Perceived target cannot be newly acquired but a separately supported established link follows its own command rule.
contracts.later_pressure: LR2-L1 exact stage/era boundaries and remaining maintenance limits.
contracts.future_freedom: Another instrument, relay or body may change the route if sourced; no universal radius copied across worlds.

contracts.title: Temporary, borrowed and historical means
contracts.operation: Choose actual supplier, continuing payer and manifestation support.
contracts.result_consumer: Actual supported ability/product with qualified remaining carrier aftermath.
contracts.missing: Historical selector, allocation and projected-material aftermath are missing in selected paths; generic supplier functions are not that lore.
contracts.failure_check: Expire one supplier during work; retain independent sources and settle consumed material by the chosen policy.
contracts.later_pressure: LR2-L2 must map supplier state.clock to the selected world clock; memory/history does not refill reserves.
contracts.future_freedom: Borrow, hire or use an independent held source through actual compatible suppliers.

contracts.title: Belief, delegated instruments and benefit destination
contracts.operation: Perform an admitted response/delegated operation while preserving the actual support recipient.
contracts.result_consumer: Qualified support/benefit and attributed response.
contracts.missing: Missing belief/recipient/delegate relation and result; no numerical belief curve or automatic transfer through custody.
contracts.failure_check: Transfer an instrument while the qualified benefit destination remains independently bound.
contracts.later_pressure: LR3-L1 stabilizing/distorting belief and support identity; not reputation alone.
contracts.future_freedom: Build support through different actual social/ritual means where qualified; no forced equal benefit for every world.

contracts.title: Acquisition exposure and protective means
contracts.operation: Acquire through a qualified channel with actual recipient and protective support.
contracts.result_consumer: Admitted knowledge and independently owned harm/condition.
contracts.missing: LR3-L2 hazard trigger/classification and KP protection capability remain gaps; KP1 is a recommendation, not accepted immunity.
contracts.failure_check: Remove support before release; apply declared acquisition policy once, with no redraw/reload re-exposure or retrospective migration harm.
contracts.later_pressure: Current recipient/body/channel/revision matters; recalling an account versus fresh external acquisition remains source-qualified.
contracts.future_freedom: The cheat may be a real protective means if qualified; ordinary UI settings neither grant immunity nor imply death risk.

contracts.title: Run modes, branches and continuation
contracts.operation: Explain selected premise/constraints separately from world mechanism and implementation support.
contracts.result_consumer: Consistent branch, obligations and source-qualified alternatives.
contracts.missing: Open-mode/pull behavior and many alternate-life consumers remain proposed; no nonfunctional mode selector.
contracts.failure_check: An unavailable canon-run choice is not reported as a universal magical impossibility, and no future locked event is revealed.
contracts.later_pressure: Later divergent histories must preserve receipts/source revisions rather than rewrite an early committed past.
contracts.future_freedom: A future free/non-lead fixture uses the same supported mechanics without protagonist identity checks; new worlds retain their own premises.

reviewedOverrideContract.key: existing scene beat + # + one-based historical step; never renumber after splitting source operations
required: actual command/export or concrete proposed signature with named missing producer/consumer
task controls/input/current quote/commit/feedback and connected predecessor/result/return
failure/refusal/interruption; durable receipt and in-flight/save revision
later-source pressure and mechanism-grounded alternative distinct from canon-mode lock
reviewedOverrideContract.newSourceSituations: separate source-linked candidate ledger; overlap and semantic deduplication before changing historical denominator
reviewedOverrideContract.dailyLife: DL1–DL16 supplement applies within finite source windows; no generic daily-life checkbox or universal needs/reputation/faction meter
reviewedOverrideContract.sharing: DL7; incumbent export + two demonstrated consumers or exact second-consumer gap; world-specific metaphysics/clock/support/knowledge laws remain separate
reviewedOverrideContract.truthBoundary: A reviewed UI proposal does not establish an installed command, current engine connection or journey proof.
